headline: Interest rates perspective
detail: The 10-year Treasury yield is inching higher. This can put pressure on tech and growth stocks, which are sensitive to borrowing costs and discount rates.
rec: Monitor the 10-year Treasury yield. If it continues to rise, consider trimming leveraged positions.

headline: Drone stocks rally on tariffs
detail: Tariffs on foreign-made drone components are boosting domestic drone stocks. This is a sector-specific catalyst.
rec: This headline is sector-specific and does not directly impact your current tech/chip holdings.

headline: OpenAI talent exodus
detail: Significant talent leaving OpenAI ahead of an IPO is a major red flag for the AI sector. This could impact sentiment around AI-related companies.
rec: This news could create headwinds for AI-focused tech names. Monitor sentiment in the AI space.
